## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for an account's usage state from the holder's standpoint — the open set (active, dormant, historical, …) an [`OnlineAccount`](gmeow-OnlineAccount.md) declares through [`gmeow:accountStatus`](../properties/gmeow-accountStatus.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the underlying service's liveness (use [`gmeow:ServiceStatus`](gmeow-ServiceStatus.md)) and avoid per-status subclasses; statuses are individuals on an open value vocabulary.

### How to use

- Reference the seeded [`gmeow:AccountStatus`](gmeow-AccountStatus.md) individuals from an account via [`gmeow:accountStatus`](../properties/gmeow-accountStatus.md); a retired account takes the historical value and is kept on record rather than deleted (P10).
